_meta.source: Figma file uI6oKmJ0qDhsEuE0nFah2W, catalog page "Process / Blocks" (node 1328:2829).
_meta.purpose: Atomic fragments of a multi-step flow, captured 1:1 from the catalog block frames. patterns.json composes them via $ref.
_meta.spacingModel: Stepper items sit at gap md in one row. A step's heading pair is one block at lg. The step content column separates its blocks at xl. The nav row is hug at gap md.
_meta.stateModel: One rendered frame = ONE step. A completed stepper item carries the check icon, a pending one is the bare label. Prototyping is out of scope: deliver each step as its own static frame.
_meta.placeholders: <Angle brackets> mark content the agent MUST replace. <Trailing?> marks an optional node: drop it when no content applies, never render it empty.

process.stepper-step-done.purpose: Completed stepper item: check icon plus the step name.

process.stepper-step.purpose: Pending or current stepper item: the step name alone.

process.stepper.purpose: Horizontal stepper: completed steps first, then the remaining ones.

process.progress.purpose: Counter line above a determinate progress bar.

process.step-title.purpose: Step heading pair: h2 title with an optional large description.

process.navigation.purpose: Step navigation: Back as ghost, Next as the Brand action.

process.success.purpose: Confirmation content: check-circle icon, centered h1, description and one action.
